capabilities: Review per-file diffs in a sidebar panel and editor-tab diff view
Commit all changes or a single file, and discard individual file changes
Push and pull from a configured remote with automatic upstream setup
Auto-commit on an interval or when changed files/lines reach a threshold
Browse the last 30 commits with a heatmap and weekly trend charts
extras: Manifest carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice. README warns against keeping the vault on a sync drive (OneDrive, iCloud) while using Git, and notes no branch switching, merging, or per-hunk staging yet.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in version control, so tracking and backing up vault changes with Git means leaving the app for the terminal.

relations.evidence: close in spirit to VS Code's Source Control

summary: Git panel for the vault: review diffs in a sidebar, commit per file or in bulk, push and pull, and auto-commit on interval or change thresholds.
